## What's this

<!-- New template, or a fix to an existing one? One template/fix per PR. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `template.json`'s `"author"` is my own GitHub username
- [ ] `template.json` has `"published": false` (unless this only touches
      metadata like `notes`/`tags` on an already-published template)
- [ ] `npm run gen` runs clean (procedural templates only)
- [ ] Mesh(es) checked in a glTF viewer — geometry looks right, parts
      (if multi-part) don't overlap
- [ ] Zones sit on the faces they're meant to, and `width`/`height` don't
      overrun the part
- [ ] `notes` describe orientation, supports, and multi-colour/assembly
      guidance

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.
